story_candidates.title: Neuraspace of Coimbra raises 15.6 million euros for AI space software

ai_path.connection: Direct: Neuraspace's products are AI-enabled (the official item says its platform combines sensor data with AI-driven risk assessment and autonomous decision support, for satellite traffic and space domain awareness).
ai_path.places: Coimbra and Portugal; customers named by the item: the European Space Agency, NATO and a European ministry of defence; the item stresses Europe's technological sovereignty.

story_candidates.angle: AICEP's official news item says Coimbra-based Neuraspace has secured 15.6 million euros, from Lince Capital, Explorer Investments and Armilar Venture Partners with support from the Recovery and Resilience Plan, to build out its AI-enabled space traffic and space domain awareness products. The item's own account of the company: founded in 2020, revenue growth of more than 350 percent in a year, more than 600 satellites monitored, the European Space Agency among its customers. It does not explain the models or how people check the decisions.
story_candidates.note: For journalist-portugal. Ready. Conditions: re-read the AICEP item yourself; one source, so every figure and customer claim is attributed to the item or to the company ('according to AICEP', 'the company says'); say what the item does not give (models, human checks, results, executive names); no private information; put the AI path in the story in plain words and with its source: the AI connection is direct (AI-driven risk assessment and autonomous decision support for satellite traffic), 0 steps away, places Coimbra and Portugal, with ESA, NATO and a European ministry of defence named as customers; categories Portugal and AI.
